cases.case_label: Founder SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (XDP) - somatic CCCTCT repeat instability
cases.mechanism_detail: Characterises tissue-specific, length-dependent somatic expansion of the CCCTCT repeat within the XDP SVA in blood and brain of XDP individuals; repeat length inversely correlates with age at onset and death. The insertion's effect on TAF1 transcription is not studied here.
cases.quote: Among the thirteen disease-specific variants is a ~ 2.6 kb SINE-VNTR-Alu (SVA)-type retrotransposon [20] inserted in intron 32 of TAF1 [18].
